test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

My old car was__** pressed into service **__as an emergency vehicle for my ailing grandmother.

options.text: To use for a particular purpose when a special need occurs.
Used to take someone to the hospital

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"pressed into service"** means to use something for a specific purpose, especially when there is an urgent need. (विशेष आवश्यकता होने पर किसी चीज़ का उपयोग करना) • **Example:** During the storm, the old ladder was pressed into service to rescue the stranded cat. • **"To use for a particular purpose when a special need occurs"** explains the correct meaning of the idiom "pressed into service." (विशेष आवश्यकता होने पर किसी चीज़ का उपयोग करना) • **Example:** My old bicycle was pressed into service when my car broke down. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Cared for by old people** (बुजुर्गों द्वारा देखभाल किया गया) • **Example:** The elderly home is where people are cared for by old people. • **Option 2: Asking for special maintenance** (विशेष रखरखाव की मांग) • **Example:** The machine is asking for special maintenance due to its age. • **Option 4: Used to take someone to the hospital** (किसी को अस्पताल ले जाने के लिए उपयोग किया गया) • **Example:** The ambulance was used to take someone to the hospital. 41:Tf41, **The correct answer is option 3.**
